summary: ZCode Global Build Round 3 is offering 100 million free GLM-5.3-Flash tokens to new users. This is a recurring promotional event: Round 1 ran on August 16 and was paused after about one hour due to demand; Round 2 ran August 21-23. Tokens are locked to the ZCode desktop app, do not roll over, and expire when the event ends.
claim_steps: Be a new ZCode user without an active paid coding plan.
Log into the ZCode desktop app during the promotional window.
The 100M token grant is credited automatically — no separate claim form or promo code.
Use the tokens inside ZCode before the event ends; unused tokens expire.
